title: Justice for UMKM Observatory Datasets v1
subtitle: Validated Indonesian UMKM economic indicators, legal register, and schemas
description: Justice for UMKM Observatory (v1.0, 2027-2030) led by Cecep Mustafa, Ph.D. Includes validated empirical DS05 UMKM economic indicators (278 records from Kementerian UMKM RI Capaian 2025, Klasifikasi Terbuka), verified DS09 legal information register (11 Indonesian statutes/PERMA from JDIH BPK), synthetic pipeline test fixtures (DS01, DS06, DS07), and full data dictionary. Contains zero personal data.
